capabilities.title: Market data
capabilities.text: Free daily data from Yahoo Finance with batched, cached, retrying ingestion and data-quality checks. The live pipeline also quarantines suspicious rows and logs revisions.

capabilities.title: Portfolio accounting
capabilities.text: Cash-only accounts by default; margin research only when explicitly enabled. Accounting invariants are checked on every simulated bar.

capabilities.title: Execution and costs
capabilities.text: Scheduled rebalancing, no-trade bands, minimum trade sizes, turnover budgets and one explicit transaction-cost convention.

capabilities.title: Machine learning
capabilities.text: Purged walk-forward validation, six model types including XGBoost and LightGBM, and a model store with feature-schema hashes.

capabilities.title: Statistics
capabilities.text: Overlap-robust inference, multiple-testing correction and pre-registered hypotheses with evidence-based verdicts.

capabilities.title: Risk management
capabilities.text: Optional adaptive drawdown and volatility-target overlays; the most restrictive limit always wins.

capabilities.title: Prospective research
capabilities.text: An append-only, hash-chained ledger that labels a decision prospective only when its timestamps prove it.

capabilities.title: Monitoring
capabilities.text: Read-only health checks, ledger diagnosis and an end-to-end reproducibility audit.
